description: Symbolic merge-and-shrink builds an abstraction heuristic whose abstract states (*classes*) are BDDs over the bits of the variables merged so far. A linear strategy merges one variable at a time, goal variables first, and splits each class by the values of the new variable. When the classes need more BDD nodes than a limit, classes with equal goal distance merge first, then the classes with the smallest distances. The final goal distances are exact in the final abstraction, so the heuristic never overestimates; without a limit, it is the perfect heuristic `h*`. Use it with BDDA* or as a SymBA* perimeter.

papers.authors: Álvaro Torralba, Carlos Linares López, Daniel Borrajo
papers.title: Symbolic Merge-and-Shrink for Cost-Optimal Planning
papers.venue: Proceedings of the Twenty-Third International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI)
